predictedBugs: Race: route.subscribe fires synchronously and may overwrite activeTab before/after navigate() lands. Mitigated: navigate() is called before route.subscribe, so window.location.hash is set before current() is read inside the subscribe.

saveNav() runs on first mount via $effect even when user has no preference, so the very first paint writes {collapsed:false, route:'home'} to localStorage. This is desired (AC #8) but means DEFAULTS is not 'no save'.

selectTab short-circuits when clicking the already-active tab, so re-clicking does not re-write the hash; this is correct but worth noting as a subtle behavior change from the original (which simply reassigned activeTab).
edgeCases: localStorage disabled (private mode) -> safeStorage() returns null, all functions no-op, defaults used. Behavior verified by inspection; not explicitly tested.
Malformed JSON in localStorage -> JSON.parse throws, caught, returns DEFAULTS. Tested.
Unknown route segment in hash or saved state -> sanitize() and parseHash() fall back to DEFAULT_ROUTE. Tested.
Hash with trailing slash (#/home/) -> regex accepts, segment normalizes. Tested implicitly via parseHash tests; not separately asserted but covered by behavior of default routes.
Mixed-case hash (#/Providers) -> regex with /i flag plus .toLowerCase() normalizes. Not separately tested.
